BitForex, a centralized cryptocurrency exchange, abruptly ceased operations after nearly $56.5 million was drained from hot wallets across Ethereum, Bitcoin, and TRON. Users lost access, withdrawals stopped, and the exchange's leadership became unreachable, with evidence strongly suggesting a coordinated exit scam. BitForex's privileged access to its hot wallets enabled the transfer of funds out of the exchange without external scrutiny or effective user protection.
